brief:
Israeli occupation authorities transferred Palestinian journalist Moaaz Amarneh to administrative detention for four months without filing charges against him, Shehab Wire reported. Amarneh, who is wounded, was moved to the detention order as part of what rights groups say is an ongoing campaign targeting Palestinian journalists.

The decision comes amid continued arrests and prosecution of Palestinian media workers by occupation forces.

title: Occupation forces place wounded journalist Moaaz Amarneh in administrative detention
